title: Secretomes of mesenchymal stromal cells and leukocyte and platelet rich fibrin
projectDescription: The objective of the present study was to compare the secretome of BMSC (BMSC-CM) to that of L-PRF (LPRF-CM) – an established standard for GF therapy, in the context of wound healing and regeneration.
sampleProcessingProtocol: The proteomic profiles of BMSC-CM (n=3 BMSC donors) and LPRF-CM (n=3 L-PRF donors) were analyzed using LC-MS/MS through Label Free Quantitation (LFQ). Briefly, total protein concentrations of BMSC-CM and LPRF-CM were measured using bicinchoninic acid assay (Pierce BCA Kit, Thermo Fisher) and 10 μg protein was processed to obtain tryptic peptides. About 0.5 µg protein as tryptic peptides dissolved in 2% acetonitrile and 0.5% formic acid, was injected into an Ultimate 3000 RSLC system connected online to a Exploris 480 mass spectrometer equipped with EASY-spray nano-electrospray ion source (all from Thermo Scientific, Sunnyvale, CA, USA).
dataProcessingProtocol: A systematic bioinformatic approach was applied to analyze the data herein. LC-MS/MS raw files were searched using Proteome Discoverer software (version 2.5.0.400; Thermo Scientific) and data were analyzed using Perseus software (version 2.3.0.1)

references.referenceLine: Al-Sharabi N, Gruber R, Sanz M, Mohamed-Ahmed S, Kristoffersen EK, Mustafa K, Shanbhag S. Proteomic Analysis of Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Secretome in Comparison to Leukocyte- and Platelet-Rich Fibrin. Int J Mol Sci. 2023 24(17):13057
